_about: Manual corrections for the Science and Technology reports tracker, for things the Parliament APIs do not have yet. Each entry finds a report by its title (capitals and punctuation are ignored). 'debate' is a Lords debate on the report that has been scheduled: give its date as YYYY-MM-DD and, optionally, a short 'note'. The tracker shows it in a light green box until Hansard has a debate on the report on or after that date; then this entry is ignored and can be deleted.
